repo_meta_data.description: Be present. Reprise remembers. An open-source call recorder for macOS: it notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, FaceTime and more, and records both sides at about 1% CPU, and the screen if you want, to plain files. It keeps the call through a lost mic, a new headset or a crash. Native Swift, no dependencies, MIT.
